title: One-Sided Randomized Membership
statement: The language of paired encodings of two well-formed algebraic circuits on the same number of inputs whose associated integer polynomials are equal belongs to co-RP with polynomial time bound, where acceptance is certain on inputs outside the language and the probability of outputting true is at least $2/3$ on inputs in the language.
